meta.name: aed:social-proof
meta.description: Optional. URL to a JSON feed (same shape as the inline `aed-social-proof-feed` block). Use this when the feed is dynamic / fetched from a backend.

json.description: Array of toast messages cycled in the corner of the page. Use this OR the meta-fetched URL.

text.description: Body. Supports **bold** via Markdown-style emphasis. Required per entry.

dwellMs.description: Milliseconds before the first toast appears.

displayMs.description: Milliseconds each toast remains on screen.

maxCycles.description: Stop after this many cycles through the feed. Omit for infinite.

hideOnPaths.description: Paths to suppress the toasts on.
